water_bottle.reason: Plastic bottle. Empty it, and recycle if your city accepts rigid plastics.

pop_bottle.reason: Plastic bottle. These are the easiest plastic to recycle.

beer_bottle.reason: Glass bottle. Glass bin — one of the most recyclable materials there is.

wine_bottle.reason: Glass bottle. Glass bin — cork and metal cap come off first.

pill_bottle.reason: Plastic medicine bottle. Empty it, remove the label and cap first.

water_jug.reason: Large plastic jug. Recycle if accepted, otherwise landfill.

milk_can.reason: Metal can. Metal bin — steel is infinitely recyclable.

cocktail_shaker.reason: Metal shaker / bottle. Metal bin — stainless steel and copper are recyclable.

pitcher.reason: Glass or plastic pitcher. Recyclable container.

lotion.reason: Plastic or metal bottle. Empty and rinse before recycling.

perfume.reason: Glass or metal bottle. Glass bin / metal recycling.

red_wine.reason: Wine glass or bottle. Glass bin.

tray.reason: Serving tray. Plastic or metal trays can be recycled if clean.

espresso.reason: Ceramic cup or takeaway coffee cup. Ceramics and lined cups go to landfill.

cup.reason: Paper or plastic cup. Check the material — paper cups with a plastic lining go to landfill.

coffee_mug.reason: Ceramic mug. Donate it if it's intact — ceramics contaminate glass recycling.

beer_glass.reason: Glass. Glass bin — this is exactly what glass recycling is for.

plate.reason: Leftover food goes to compost. The plate itself is ceramic — never the glass bin.

soup_bowl.reason: Ceramic bowl. Ceramics contaminate glass recycling.

mixing_bowl.reason: Usually ceramic or glass — if ceramic, it goes to landfill.

wok.reason: Non-stick coated metal. Recyclers reject coated pans.

frying_pan.reason: Coated metal. Recyclers reject coated cookware.

pot.reason: Flowerpot. Terracotta and ceramic go to landfill; rigid plastic pots can often be recycled.

potpie.reason: Food waste. Compost bin — a foil dish goes to metal recycling.

coffeepot.reason: Glass or ceramic coffeepot — heat-resistant glass is not bottle glass, so landfill.

teapot.reason: Usually ceramic. Not recyclable with glass.

can_opener.reason: Metal tool. Donate it if it works, otherwise scrap metal / metal bin.

steel_drum.reason: Steel drum. Metal bin — heavy steel is highly recyclable.

bottlecap.reason: Metal cap. Metal bin — keep caps on the bottle when possible.

oil_filter.reason: Contains oil residue. Take to an oil collection point.

safety_pin.reason: Small metal. Collect small bits in a steel can, then metal bin.

nail.reason: Small metal. Collect small bits in a steel can, then metal bin.

screw.reason: Small metal. Collect small bits in a steel can, then metal bin.

carton.reason: Carton. Many cities accept them, but check your local rule.

packet.reason: Likely a foil or plastic wrapper — multilayer, so landfill.

envelope.reason: Paper envelope. Paper bin — window envelopes go to landfill.

book_jacket.reason: Paper. Paper bin — glossy laminated covers go to landfill.

binder.reason: Vinyl and metal parts make this hard to recycle.

pencil_box.reason: Often metal or plastic — check your local rule for small plastic items.

ballpoint.reason: Pen. Mixed plastic, metal and ink — landfill.

pencil_sharpener.reason: Small mixed-metal and plastic item. Landfill.

letter_opener.reason: Metal. Scrap-metal / metal bin — wrap the blade first.

paper_towel.reason: Used paper towel. Contaminated by food — landfill.

banana.reason: Food waste. Compost bin — it becomes soil, not methane in a landfill.

pineapple.reason: Food waste. Compost bin — the tough crown composts too.

pizza.reason: Food waste. Compost bin — but the greasy box is landfill.

cheeseburger.reason: Food waste. Compost bin — the wrapper is landfill.

hotdog.reason: Food waste. Compost bin — the wrapper is landfill.

burrito.reason: Food waste. Compost bin — foil goes to metal recycling if clean.

wooden_spoon.reason: Wooden utensil. Compost bin if unvarnished.

cellular_telephone.reason: E-waste. Never in household bins — find the e-waste drop-off.

laptop.reason: E-waste. Contains valuable metals and hazardous materials.

notebook.reason: Laptop. E-waste — the lithium battery inside must never go in a household bin.

monitor.reason: E-waste. Screens contain lead and mercury.

screen.reason: E-waste. Screens contain lead and mercury.

television.reason: E-waste. Large electronics need proper collection.

mouse.reason: E-waste. Small electronics are still e-waste.

joystick.reason: E-waste. Small electronics are still e-waste.

remote_control.reason: E-waste. Take the batteries out — they go to battery collection.

printer.reason: E-waste. Large electronics need proper collection.

projector.reason: E-waste. Large electronics need proper collection.

loudspeaker.reason: E-waste. Magnets and wiring — e-waste drop-off.

digital_watch.reason: E-waste. Button cell inside — e-waste drop-off.

hard_disc.reason: E-waste. Data-bearing device — wipe or destroy it first.

iPod.reason: E-waste. Old battery inside — proper drop-off.

power_drill.reason: E-waste. Power tools go to e-waste collection.

table_lamp.reason: E-waste. Bulb and wiring need proper handling.

wool.reason: Textile. Landfill unless you have a textile collection point.

jersey.reason: Textile. Donate it if wearable — otherwise textile collection or landfill.

sock.reason: Textile. Textile collection if available, otherwise landfill.

candle.reason: Wax. Landfill — metal candle tins can be recycled.

ashcan.reason: Metal trash can. Clean steel cans are recyclable.

lighter.reason: Flammable fuel. Special drop-off — these poison recycling batches.

hair_spray.reason: Pressurised aerosol. Hazardous drop-off unless completely empty.

matchstick.reason: Used matches go in general waste — make sure they're fully out.

syringe.reason: Sharps. Special drop-off — never in a household bin.

soap_dispenser.reason: Mixed plastic with a metal-spring pump. Landfill unless your city accepts pumps.

paintbrush.reason: Solvent and pigment residue. Special drop-off, not household bins.

plastic_bag.reason: Soft film plastic wraps around recycling machinery. Landfill.

diaper.reason: Sad but true — this one can't be recycled.
